relationships.subject: TNFα
relationships.evidence_quote: Intrathecal injection of tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNFα) upregulated mPGES-1 mRNA in blood vessels in the spinal cord.

relationships.subject: spinal endothelial cells
relationships.evidence_quote: We identified that mPGES-1 mRNA was upregulated in spinal endothelial cells after nerve injury and exhibited co-localization with cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2).

relationships.subject: spinal neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: EP2 mRNA and EP4 mRNA were expressed in spinal neurons in the dorsal horn.

relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: endothelial cell-derived PGE2 may act on EP2 and EP4 receptors on spinal neurons and modulate pain sensitivity

key_findings: mPGES-1 is upregulated in spinal endothelial cells after nerve injury, co-localizing with COX-2, and is induced by TNFα.
EP2 and EP4 mRNA are expressed in dorsal horn neurons; EP1 was not detected.
